nodes.exit: Completed CRABS freeze and claim ceiling are referenced; successor writes and evidence destinations are distinct.

nodes.title: Remove obsolete Task Session gate and derive truthful readiness
nodes.exit: The successor derives technical readiness from actual checks and contains no Task Session dependency, synthesized audit or authority claim.

nodes.title: Freeze L2 property and negative-control matrix
nodes.exit: Exact 48/48/2 denominator, observations, tool/source identities, bounds and selected controls are immutable for the attempt.

nodes.title: Complete R00-R04 evidence interpretation and identity
nodes.exit: Raw-derived outcome, truthful readiness, exact input/tool/command closure and CBMC decision tests pass.

nodes.title: Complete R05-R08 supervision and observations
nodes.exit: Failure-path supervision, durable recovery, per-merge observations and integrated mechanism tests pass.

nodes.title: Freeze candidate and execute 48/48/2
nodes.exit: One new immutable attempt has every declared row and a typed CRABS subject outcome.

nodes.title: Execute isolated negative controls
nodes.exit: Every frozen subject, oracle, denominator, evidence and execution control produces the expected non-pass.

nodes.title: Compare L2 evidence and explain result
nodes.exit: Assessment binds real and mutant results, explains any defect, preserves conflict and states residual scope.

nodes.title: Assign independent L2 reviewer
nodes.exit: Named reviewer, private access, environment and independence disclosure are recorded.

nodes.title: Perform independent L2 replay
nodes.exit: Reviewer reproduces the frozen attempt and control outcomes or records attributable disagreement.

nodes.title: Decide L2 promotion
nodes.exit: Promote, remediate, narrow or stop based on complete author and reviewer evidence.

nodes.title: Select Auth Foundation property and owner
nodes.exit: Product owner selects the Auth Foundation authorization property as the replacement L3 target; meaning provenance, candidate lineage and exclusions are explicit.

nodes.title: Freeze and evaluate Auth Foundation transfer
nodes.exit: A fresh exact source/tool/property binding yields a typed result for the 48 obligations, six behavioral mutants, twelve hostile controls and two EVF routes; any actual defect is preserved before repair.

nodes.title: Independently replay Auth Foundation transfer
nodes.exit: A separate technical reviewer reproduces the frozen Auth result and reusable-core versus Auth-specific effort is measured.

nodes.title: Assemble measured service candidate
nodes.exit: Private offering, intake, report, evidence, data-boundary and pilot-acceptance templates trace to earned evidence and observed cost.

nodes.title: Decide pilot readiness
nodes.exit: Product owner selects propose one bounded pilot, revise, or defer; no customer contact occurs under this plan.

blockers.description: Product owner has not reviewed a concrete measured service candidate.

claim_ceiling: L2 supports a bounded, same-host, independently replayed no-counterexample result for 48 native cases, 48 sanitizer runs and two actual-C CBMC representatives. L3 supports a bounded, same-host Auth result with 48 product checks, six seeded mutants, twelve hostile controls, two EVF routes and one real evidence-pipeline defect repaired and independently replayed. The private service candidate derives only from those exact results. No general proof, product admission, certification, publication, release or deployment follows.
